	`id` bigint AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,

	`artist` varchar(255) NOT NULL,

	`playedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `songHistory_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
